preconditions.description: fullText and searchText must be strings.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 0 if searchText == '' else sum(fullText[i:].startswith(searchText) for i in range(len(fullText) - len(searchText) + 1)) if allowOverlap else sum(fullText[i:].startswith(searchText) for i in range(len(fullText) - len(searchText) + 1) if i == 0 or fullText[i-1] != searchText[0])
postconditions.description: The return value is the number of non-overlapping occurrences of searchText in fullText.
